boost_if_present.why: A lean code alongside misfire suggests lean misfire — address the lean condition before condemning ignition parts.
A lean code alongside misfire suggests lean misfire — address the lean condition before condemning ignition parts.

explanation: The ECU detected combustion events that were weak or absent. A misfire code names the cylinder that misfired, not the part that caused it.

repairs.label: Replace ignition coil on the misfiring cylinder
repairs.verification: Rescan after repair; Mode 06 misfire counts should stay at zero over several drive cycles.

repairs.label: Replace spark plugs
repairs.verification: Rescan; misfire counts should stay at zero and the plug gap should match spec.

repairs.label: Injector diagnosis (balance test), then replace as indicated
repairs.verification: An injector balance test isolates the faulty injector before any part is bought.

repairs.label: Compression / leak-down test at a shop
repairs.verification: A compression test confirms or rules out mechanical causes before any engine work.

safety.stop_message: A flashing check-engine light means catalyst-damaging misfire: stop driving and seek professional service.

conditions.note: Mode 06 test ID $0B misfire counts per cylinder, one snapshot. NOT implemented on the current transport — the coil-swap test is the supported decisive path.

tests.question: Read per-cylinder misfire counts (Mode 06). Which cylinder dominates?

follows_coil.label: Misfire followed the coil to the new cylinder

inconclusive.label: Test inconclusive (codes unclear, drive too short)

stays_on_cylinder.label: Misfire stayed on the original cylinder

tests.question: Swap the coil from the misfiring cylinder to a healthy one, clear codes, drive, and rescan. Did the misfire follow the coil to the new cylinder?

fouled.label: Plug fouled, oil-soaked, cracked, or gap out of spec

tests.question: Remove the plug from the misfiring cylinder. Is it fouled, oil-soaked, cracked, or is the gap far out of spec?

title: Cylinder misfire detected
